listen: Good morning. This is The Daily Brief for Thursday, October 15, 2026. Our lead story: President Trump has forced out Kimberly Guilfoyle, his ambassador to Greece. She faced allegations of misconduct before and during her time at the U.S. Embassy in Athens. She has denied the allegations. The White House publicly asked for her resignation on Tuesday. Now the front page. A school roof collapsed in northwestern Pakistan on Thursday. At least 28 children and a female teacher were killed, and more than 50 people were injured. Pope Leo the Fourteenth has been diagnosed with lung cancer, according to the Vatican. Georgia's early voting opened with nearly 189,000 ballots cast on the first day. Nexus, a new AI supercomputer, has been unveiled at Georgia Tech's data center. In Tech and AI, Claude now offers OpenTelemetry export in beta, for tracing API requests and agent sessions. In Politics, Drop Site News reports on donors linked to Jeffrey Epstein giving to Ashley Moody's Senate campaign. In World, Ukraine says SpaceX's Starshield access has been greatly restricted. In Sports, four men have been arrested over the February shooting of 49ers lineman Keion White. In Atlanta, the Georgia Supreme Court struck down Chatham County's fire service fee. In Architecture, AEC Magazine looks at Motif, an AI-driven BIM platform. In Science and Nature, Voyager 1 will reach one light-day from Earth on November 18. That is the brief. Have a good day.

lead.title: U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle resigns following misconduct allegations
lead.note: President Trump has forced out Kimberly Guilfoyle, his ambassador to Greece, after allegations of misconduct before and during her tenure at the U.S. Embassy in Athens. The White House publicly asked for her resignation on Tuesday as accusations mounted. Guilfoyle has denied the allegations, according to the report. NPR's coverage includes an interview with a former White House ethics lawyer, Richard Painter, who discussed the ethics allegations facing her. The story is a political one: a senior diplomatic post is vacant after a resignation the White House requested. For readers following the administration, it is a fresh example of personnel decisions tied to conduct questions. Coverage so far has been limited to the allegations, the resignation, and reactions from ethics experts, so further facts may follow.
lead.follow_up: The resignation is now confirmed, after the White House publicly asked for it on Tuesday.
